+import {
+  asphalt_strip, centre_dashes, curb_cut, parking_stall, birch_tree, hedge_run, light_pole,
+  SMOOTH_STONE, COARSE_DIRT, SHORT_GRASS, DANDELION, SITE_SIZE, rng,

+// The sidewalk and apron are smooth stone: a flat set of cells on y=0.
+function stone(g, x0, z0, x1, z1, block) {
+  for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) g.set(x, 0, z, block);
+// A birch like birch_tree, but the crown is clipped to the lot: the east tree at x=40 has its crown past x=41.
+function birch(g, x, z) {
+  const leaf = { persistent: "true" };
+  const put = (px, py, pz, block, state) => {
+    if (g.inBounds(px, py, pz)) g.set(px, py, pz, block, state);
+  for (let y = 1; y <= 5; y++) put(x, y, z, "birch_log", { axis: "y" });
+  for (let y = 4; y <= 6; y++) for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
+    if (!(Math.abs(dx) === 2 && Math.abs(dz) === 2)) put(x + dx, y, z + dz, "birch_leaves", leaf);
+  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) put(x + dx, 7, z + dz, "birch_leaves", leaf);
+export function build(g) {
+  // Street: asphalt on z0..4, the yellow centre line at z=2 (3 on, 3 off) laid on the asphalt.
+  asphalt_strip(g, 0, 0, 41, 4, { replace: true });
+  centre_dashes(g, 0, 41, 2);
+  // Sidewalk: smooth stone on z5..6 across the whole frontage, then the two curb cuts paved in asphalt.
+  stone(g, 0, 5, SITE_SIZE[0] - 1, 6, SMOOTH_STONE);
+  curb_cut(g, 7, 14, { over: true });
+  curb_cut(g, 27, 34, { over: true });
+  // Forecourt drive (x6..35, z7..23) and the front lane (x1..34, z21..23) are one asphalt field.
+  asphalt_strip(g, 6, 7, 35, 23, { replace: true });
+  asphalt_strip(g, 1, 21, 34, 23, { replace: true });
+  // Store apron: smooth stone paving in front of the storefront (plan APRON 9..32, z21..23).

+  // West parking: asphalt on x1..7, z24..33, three stalls whose stripes sit on z23, 26, 29, 32 (nose west).
+  asphalt_strip(g, 1, 24, 7, 33, { replace: true });
+  parking_stall(g, 1, 23, 26);
+  parking_stall(g, 1, 29, 32);
+  // Verges: grass stays the base. Coarse dirt patches sit near the trunks (never under one), with short grass and

+  for (const [x, z] of dirt) g.set(x, 0, z, COARSE_DIRT);
+  const pick = rng(7);
+    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) for (let z = 7; z <= 20; z++) {

+      const r = pick();
+      if (r < 0.12) g.set(x, 1, z, SHORT_GRASS);
+      else if (r < 0.14) g.set(x, 1, z, DANDELION);
+  // Birch trees on the verges (trunks on grass), the east one clipped by the lot edge.

+  // Light poles at the street-side corners of the lot, on the drive edge.
+  light_pole(g, 5, 21);

# Plan: modern gas station with convenience store (FORM)

Identity: a crisp roadside fuel stop. A big flat white canopy with a red brand stripe floats on slim columns over two pump islands; behind it a low flat-roofed store: a glass storefront volume (white) beside a taller grey service block, under a red fascia sign. Price pylon at the street corner. White / grey / black / one red.

## SITE

Lot 42 wide (x 0..41) by 38 deep (z 0..37). Front faces NORTH (-z); x runs along the street. Ground surface is the y=0 layer everywhere (flat); everything stands on y=1. Store floor is at y=0 (flush, no steps).

| Street (asphalt) | 0..41 | 0 | 0..4 | yellow dashed centre line at z=2 (3 on, 3 off) |

| Pump island B (curb) | 26..27 | 1 | 11..18 | raised 1 |

make.sh builds a whole build.nbt: my part placed 1209 blocks, 0 refused, 0 off-palette. mcd check: no floating or unsupported blocks, walkable end to end. The tiles show the street, sidewalk, curb cuts and apron where the plan puts them.
Ticked plan.md item 5 and the matching elements.md items; added a Notes line on the clipped birch and on replace for ground repaving.
left: Other parts' issue, not this part: roof.json puts off-palette blocks into the Store shell (smooth_stone_stairs x40, andesite_slab x40, stone_slab x64). make.sh reports it on the shell line; it needs fixing in the roof spec.
The tree at (40,0,16): only the part of its crown inside the lot is built (the x=42 cells are off the grid). If the plan wants the full crown, the grid would need to grow.

waste.what: The east birch (40,0,16) has a crown that runs past x=41, so birch_tree throws on the out-of-bounds cell. I wrote a local clipped birch() by hand.
waste.cost: One failed make.sh run plus a rewrite of the tree routine (about 15 lines).
waste.tool: birch_tree (and the other tree/crown helpers) should clip to the grid, or take a bounds option, instead of throwing.

waste.what: Ground surface writes: the helpers only write into air unless told to replace, and the ground is grass_block from build.mjs. I had to work out which helpers need { replace: true } and which (centre_dashes, parking_stall) only paint over asphalt, and then order the asphalt before the paint.
waste.cost: About six reads of helper sources to learn the replace/paint rules before the first build.
waste.tool: A ground helper such as repave(g, box, block) that declares it overwrites the y=0 base, plus a note in the vocabulary comments saying paint helpers only lay over gray_concrete_powder.

waste.what: Scattered short_grass, dandelion and coarse_dirt patches were picked cell by cell with a hand-rolled loop and hand-chosen patch coordinates, avoiding tree trunks.
waste.cost: About 15 coordinates written by hand plus one seeded loop.
waste.tool: A scatter(g, box, {blocks, density, avoid, seed}) helper that places plant and ground patches on a surface and skips listed cells.

waste.what: Verified the sidewalk/curb-cut/apron layout by eye from the front-left tile only; no overlay of the plan's coordinates on the render.
waste.cost: One render plus one look; no plan-vs-build cell check for the parking and pole positions.
waste.tool: mcd plan-diff, or a 'mcd zoom --at' check against plan.md's coordinates for each element of the part.
